features: 3 IN 1 MULTIFUNCTIONAL TYPE C CABLE: (Note: Not recommended for use with hub, compatibility issues can arise.) This USB C to USB C cable incorporates charging, data transmission and video output into one. Whether you need to transfer files, sync data, or stream videos, this cable can handle it all. Built in high tech smart chip, automatically distribute proper current and control voltage, maintaining the good performance of batteries and devices

PD 100W & 10 GBPS DATA TRANSFER: Upgrade Type C 3.1 cable is 100W supports max 100W PD3.0 /QC3.0 charging for laptop, phone, tablet with USB C port, greatly improve the charging efficiency and save lots of charging time. In addition, enables the devices to transfer or copy data, files at the speed of at max 10Gbps.(Note: If you want to achieve a maximum charging power of 100W/10Gbps, you need to meet the requirement that both the device and the adapter support 100W/10Gbps power.)

4K HD OUTPUT: This USB C to USB C Cable allows you to connect MacBook to an external monitor or screen at max 4K HD video output, perfect for syncing content, videos, movies to larger screen (NOTE: Please make sure the devices can support DisplayPort Alternative Mode (Alt Mode)

PREMIUM DURABILITY & METAL CONNECTOR: 1M/3.3FT high performance TYPE C to TYPE C cable, sturdy and well made nylon braided cable, wear resistance and anti-bends ensures longer service life. High performance aluminum alloy connector design has better durability and conductivity, standing with constantly use

WIDE COMPATIBILITY: Proper cable length provides enough room of maneuvering, more convenient to use. Works with most TYPE C enabled devices, including for Mac for Macbook for Macbook Pro for ipad for Realme Phone MacBook Pro 2016/2017/2018/2019, etc. (Note: Not recommended for use with hub, compatibility issues can arise.)
